verdict.rationale: llamafile runs entirely on-device with no cloud calls and explicitly blocks outbound networking ('No outbound network... only networking the server can do is answer connections it received'), so there is no channel for user data to reach a vendor for training — this is corroborated by a community report of it running with 'zero network connection.' missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement/policy about training-data usage (the guarantee is architectural/inferred rather than stated as a data-training policy) and independent audit of the network claim.
